jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Tauranga City Council; comparative only, not Alberta

facts.text: The decision under review is the authority's grant of building consent BC331457 under section 72, subject to notice to the Registrar-General of Land under section 73(1)(c).
The consent is for a new 1,256m2 storage facility on a level industrial property of about 2.1 hectares.
The neighbouring property to the east includes a 30 m high densely vegetated slope with an average slope angle of 33 degrees.
The consent application included a geotechnical report confirming there was good ground on the storage facility site.
Table 1 gives site-specific factor-of-safety results; Figure 1 is a property and storage facility site plan.
